folder.programOutside: The game's program is not inside its folder
folder.none: The game has no install folder
folder.driveTop: The game is at the top of a drive
folder.inWindows: The game is inside the Windows folder
folder.systemFolder: {folder} is a system or user folder (or holds one), so it is not deleted
folder.playoutFolder: {folder} holds PlayOut, its data or your ROM / Emulation folder, so it is not deleted
folder.belowDriveTop: {folder} sits right below the top of its drive, so it may hold more than one game
folder.storeLibrary: {folder} is a store's game library or a store's own folder
folder.inStoreLibrary: {folder} is in a store's game library ({library}); uninstall it from that store
folder.inStoreFolder: {folder} is in a store's library or folder ({store}); uninstall it from that store
folder.tooManyFiles: {folder} holds too many files to check
folder.holdsStore: {folder} holds {name}, a store's folder or program
folder.tooManyFolders: {folder} holds too many folders to check
folder.holdsStoreInner: {folder} holds {name}, a store's folder or program
folder.holdsOtherGame: {folder} also holds {name}, which looks like another game

uninstaller.storeProgram: Its uninstaller is a store's program ({name}); uninstall it from that store
uninstaller.removesOther: {reason}, so its uninstaller would remove that game too

refused.notInLibrary: This game is not in the library
refused.otherPc: {title} is on another PC; there is nothing to delete here
refused.notInstalled: {title} is not installed on this PC
refused.queued: {title} is in the download queue. Remove it from the queue first.
refused.notHere: This game cannot be deleted from here

rom.systemFolder: {path} is a system folder of the ROM folder
rom.noFolder: No ROM folder is set, so the files cannot be checked
rom.converting: A conversion is running. Wait for it to finish.
rom.heldImage: {path} holds a disc image PlayOut keeps aside while it checks a recompilation; answer that question first
rom.allShared: Every file of this game is also used by another game

image.inRecycleBin: The disc image of {title} is already in the Recycle Bin (it starts its recompilation)
image.none: {title} has no disc image on this PC
image.downloading: A paired PC is downloading it right now
image.gameGone: the game is not in the library
image.noRecycleBin: {file} could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (a network drive or a drive without one?). Nothing was deleted.
image.partial: Only {moved} of {total} files went to the Recycle Bin (restore them from there); {file} could not be moved.

uninstall.settingsOpen: Windows Settings is open: uninstall {title} from Apps there
uninstall.storeOpen: {store} is open: uninstall {title} from its library
uninstall.notFound: The uninstaller of {title} was not found

files.noRecycleBin: {title} could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (a network drive or a drive without one?). Nothing was deleted.
files.partial: Only {moved} of {total} files of {title} went to the Recycle Bin (restore them from there); {file} could not be moved.
files.movedExtrasFailed: Moved {title} to the Recycle Bin; {failed} of its updates and DLC could not be moved ({files})
files.movedWithExtras: Moved {title} and its updates and DLC to the Recycle Bin

unpacked.systemFolder: {folder} sits right in a system or user folder, so it is not deleted
unpacked.saves: {folder} holds or is in your saves, states or BIOS, so it is not deleted
unpacked.link: {folder} is a link to another folder, so it is not deleted
unpacked.downloading: A paired PC is downloading from it right now
unpacked.noRecycleBin: {folder} could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (a network drive or a drive without one?). Nothing was deleted.

held.noteFailed: Nothing was deleted: PlayOut could not note what it moves ({error}).
held.stuck: {error}; {files} file(s) could not be put back and stay kept aside (PlayOut asks what to do with them).
held.otherDrive: {file} could not be moved aside on its own drive
held.notMovedByPlayOut: {path} is not a file PlayOut moved aside; nothing was restored.
held.blocked: Something is at {path} now, so nothing was restored (PlayOut never overwrites it). Move it away and choose Restore again.
held.stillAside: {error}. It is still kept aside; choose Restore again.
held.restoredMissing: Restored what was left; {files} was no longer there.
held.notMovedByPlayOutDelete: {path} is not a file PlayOut moved aside; nothing more was deleted.
held.recycleFailed: {file} could not be moved to the Recycle Bin ({error}); it is still kept aside.

hostGamesReadOnly: Host games cannot be edited on this PC
